briefdescription.para: Reads or writes a flash register.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the interface driver component to use.
Pointer that stores the value read from flash.
Pointer to the value to write into flash.
Buffer that holds the command, address, address-size, dummy, and byte count at offsets XSFL_*_OFFSET. The byte count is the payload length. In DDR-PHY mode, it is rounded up to a minimum of 2.
Whether the specific read or write requires an address.

simplesect.para: Use this API for only one flash at a time.

briefdescription.para: Transfers a command to the flash.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the interface driver component to use.
Command to transfer to the flash.

simplesect.para: Use this API for only one flash at a time.

briefdescription.para: Reads the status of the flash status register.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the interface driver component to use.

simplesect.para: Use this API for only one flash at a time.

briefdescription.para: Translates the address based on the type of interconnection.

detaileddescription.para: In case of stacked connection, the function asserts the corresponding slave select.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the interface driver component to use.
Address to access (for erase, write, or read).

simplesect.para: RealAddr, the translated address. For single connection, it is unchanged. For stacked connection, the function subtracts the lower flash size when the address is in the upper flash.
In addition to getting the actual address to work on the flash, this function also selects the CS based on the detected configuration.

briefdescription.para: Implements the SFL interface functions for flash register transfers.

detaileddescription.para: This file implements the functions required to use the serial flash library (SFL) interface hardware to perform a transfer.
